title: Rental increases at Goodman Arts Centre and affordable arts workspaces
asked: Ms Gho Sze Kee asked what measures are being considered to help tenant artists cope with significant rental increases at Goodman Arts Centre, and what longer-term plans exist to keep affordable creative workspaces accessible to arts practitioners.
response: Mr Baey Yam Keng said NAC provides arts spaces below commercial rental levels and tracks 94,000 square metres of arts gross floor area, a 42% increase since 2010. Goodman Arts Centre has 77 units, including 26 Project Studios and 51 units under the Framework for Arts Spaces scheme, subvented up to 80%. The Arts House Group will defer rate increases in 2026, and NAC and the operator will review rates at the end of this year for 2027. He also said a study on improving arts spaces provision announced last year is ongoing, with findings to be shared when ready.

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: the total arts gross floor area tracked by NAC currently stands at 94,000 square metres, which is a 42% increase since 2010

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: NAC provides such spaces at rates below commercial rental levels

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: The Goodman Arts Centre provides a total of 77 units across both short-term venues and longer-term housing options

key_points.point: Goodman Arts Centre includes 26 Project Studios for short-term tenancies up to 12 months and 51 units under the Framework for Arts Spaces scheme, subvented up to 80%.
key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng

key_points.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
key_points.quote: it will defer rate increases in 2026 to support arts tenants during this period of heightened economic uncertainty arising from the conflict in the Middle East
